rate_description: 0% individual state income tax; federal and entity-level taxes may still apply.
key_statutory_notes: Texas does not impose an individual state income tax. A 1031 exchange can still defer eligible federal gain.
No Texas individual income-tax clawback is identified in this baseline. Texas franchise tax treatment requires separate entity-specific review.
Use a qualified intermediary before receiving sale proceeds; federal identification and completion deadlines generally remain 45 and 180 days.

rate_description: 0% individual state income tax; corporations and federal taxation require separate review.
key_statutory_notes: Florida does not impose personal income tax. Federal 1031 rules still apply.
No Florida personal income-tax clawback is identified in this baseline. This does not describe corporate income tax.
Federal exchanges generally require identification within 45 days and completion within 180 days, subject to the tax-return deadline and extensions.

rate_description: Variable: capital gains are taxed as ordinary income. No single taxpayer-independent rate.
key_statutory_notes: California taxes capital gains as ordinary income; the applicable rate depends on taxable income and filing status.
Exchanging California real property for out-of-state property can preserve California-source deferred gain. Annual FTB 3840 reporting may continue through subsequent exchanges until recognition.
State conformity, residency, basis differences and applicable filing exceptions require review. This reporting obligation does not mean an immediate tax is due.
